newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WEST HAM SIGN HARTSON FROM ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEST HAM SIGN HARTSON FROM ARSENAL.

text.p: West Ham signed Arsenal's 21-year-old Welsh international striker John Hartson for a club record fee of 5.0 million pounds ($8.1 million) on Friday.

The powerfully built striker, who spent just over two years at Highbury after starting his career at Luton, will form a new strike force with Paul Kitson, who joined the Hammers from Newcastle United for 2.3 million pounds ($3.7 million) last week.
Both are expected to make their debuts in Saturday's premier league match at Derby County whch could have an important bearing on the relegation battle.

West Ham have dropped into the bottom three after winning just one of their last 13 league matches while Derby are just three points and two places better off after going nine matches without a league win.
Hartson scored Arsenal's very first goal of this season against West Ham in an opening day 2-0 victory but that was one of only four goals he has scored in 26 appearances.

Of those 26 games he has been substituted or come on as a substitute 15 times and clearly feels a move across London will give him the chance of regular first-team football -- as well as the chance of keeping West Ham in the premier league.

West Ham's previous record fee was the 2.4 million pounds ($3.9 million) they paid for Romanian international striker Florin Raducioiu who returned to his previous club Espanyol in Spain after a brief, unproductive period at Upton Park.
